stations.title: Customer
stations.say: Is my mantel clock ready yet?

stations.title: Slip says 2
stations.text: Nobody is sure what 2 means today.

stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: Kasimir is working on it now.

captions: A customer rings Dorrit to ask whether the mantel clock on ticket 3101 is ready.
The slip says 2, and nobody remembers which state 2 stands for.
You give the states names, and turn each one into words to read out.
Now Dorrit reads the same plain words every time, and knows when a clock can go home.
Repairs have named states now. Next, the repair moves into files of its own.
